simple.meaning: מָדוֹן (mâdôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “extensiveness , i.e. height.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מָדוֹן (H4067) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 21:20, with occurrences in 2 Samuel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָדוֹן (H4067) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מָדוֹן (H4067) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מָדוֹן (mâdôwn) / H4067 is traced through 2 Samuel 21:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
